selection: Supplemental candidates from English-language Wikidata entity searches. Each record carries a Wikidata QID, English label/description and the API search URL. The candidate filter excludes legal instruments, publications, products, events, transport stops, buildings, geographic entities, generic classes and non-organization topics. Final integration requires cross-deduplication by QID and normalized label against the retained local 832-record dataset.
deduplication: Unique QIDs and normalized English labels within this candidate file; cross-deduplication against the existing directory is performed by the build script.
